brief: Phoebe Bridgers' UK and Ireland tour is routed through Dublin (97), Manchester (95), Bristol (97), London (98), and Edinburgh (98) to match her indie-leaning audience profile in top-scoring markets. Birmingham, Cardiff, Glasgow, Leeds, and Liverpool were dropped due to lower fan affinity scores ranging from 89 to 96, with Birmingham specifically showing the weakest score (89) and affinity (0.891). Lucy Dacus is the top opener, sharing taste profiles in straightforward, United States, melodic, and folk music.
